name: Abihu
description: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel were called up to worship afar off, and Moses alone came near the Lord.

note.label: Exodus 24: The Blood of the Covenant

points: Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar are taken from among the children of Israel to minister unto the Most High in the priest's office.

note.label: Exodus 28: Holy Garments for Glory and for Beauty

points: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, put fire therein and incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not; and fire went out from the Lord and devoured them.

The instructions for the incense were already given: Aaron shall burn sweet incense every morning and at even, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations, and ye shall offer no strange incense thereon. There were instructions on what could be burned and what could not; the strange fire is that Nadab and Abihu put strange incense before the Lord.

note.label: Leviticus 10: Strange Fire and the Charge of the Priesthood

points: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord; go back and read that account.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

points: These are the divisions of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office. David distributed them according to their offices in their service.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests
